description: This file provides a Linux kernel device driver for accessing the Broadcom B53 switch registers via memory-mapped I/O. It includes functions for reading and writing various register sizes and handles driver initialization and cleanup.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * val)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit register from the memory-mapped address space.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register, handling endianness and validation.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit register, handling endianness and validation.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 48-bit value composed of multiple register reads.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit register by combining two 32-bit reads.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 value)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to the register.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value, handling endianness and validation.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 value)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value, handling endianness and validation.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 48-bit value across multiple registers.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value by splitting into two 32-bit writes.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_probe(struct platform_device * pdev)
methods.description: Initializes and registers the B53 switch device.

methods.name: void b53_mmap_remove(struct platform_device * pdev)
methods.description: Cleans up and unregisters the B53 switch device.
